triples.head_surface: activation of the protection of a harmonic filter circuit
triples.head_canonical_zh: 谐波滤波器电路保护动作
triples.evidence_text: Arrangements are to be provided to alert the crew in the event of activation of the protection of a harmonic filter circuit.
Additionally, there is to be installed a current unbalance detection system independent of the overcurrent protection alerting the crew in case of current unbalance.
Consideration is to be given to additional protection for the individual capacitor element as (e.g., relief valve or overpressure disconnector) in order to protect against damage from rupturing.

triples.head_surface: activation of overload or short-circuit protection
triples.tail_surface: An alarm is to be initiated in a continuously manned location
triples.evidence_text: An alarm is to be initiated in a continuously manned location in the event of an activation of overload or short-circuit protection.

triples.head_surface: current imbalance exceeds the ratings of the individual filter circuit components
triples.head_canonical_zh: 电流不平衡超过滤波器组件额定值
triples.evidence_text: If the current imbalance exceeds the ratings of the individual filter circuit components, the appropriate circuits shall automatically trip and be prevented from interacting with other parts of the electrical network.

triples.tail_surface: alarmed locally at the equipment and in a continuously manned location
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设备本地及有人值守处所报警
triples.evidence_text: Detection of capacitor(s) deterioration shall be alarmed locally at the equipment and in a continuously manned location.

triples.tail_surface: Power to the harmonic filter circuit containing the deteriorated capacitor(s) shall be automatically disconnected and the capacitor discharged safely
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 自动断开含劣化电容器的滤波器电路电源并安全放电
triples.evidence_text: Power to the harmonic filter circuit containing the deteriorated capacitor(s) shall be automatically disconnected and the capacitor discharged safely upon detection of deterioration.

triples.head_surface: leading power factor condition approaches the point of the generator(s) becoming self-excited
triples.head_canonical_zh: 超前功率因数接近发电机自激点
triples.tail_surface: appropriate capacitive circuits shall be automatically disconnected
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 相应容性电路自动断开
triples.evidence_text: In cases where a leading power factor condition approaches the point of the generator(s) becoming self-excited, the appropriate capacitive circuits shall be automatically disconnected and prevented from interacting with the rest of the electrical network.
